caption: Coins lie on the bottom of a clear fountain, and they appear to shimmer and shift as the surface ripples.

sa.check: Coins lie on the bottom of a fountain.
The coins appear to shimmer and shift.

pc.expect: The coins lie still; only their apparent position wobbles with the ripples.
pc.fail: The coins slide across the bottom; or a coin flips; or coins appear and vanish.

pc.expect: The wobble follows the ripples and stops when the water is still.
pc.fail: The image wobbles on a flat calm; or the coins are sharp on a plainly rippled surface; or the wobble continues after the water settles.

pc.expect: The coins are visible through the water.
pc.fail: The water hides them; or they are seen only above the surface; or a different set appears.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples pass and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or the water leaps.
Coins vanish; or appear; or merge.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The fountain and the coins' colours stay the same.
pc.fail: The basin changes; or the coins change colour; or the surroundings rearrange.
